title: Long Description; Category and Vendor truncate on hover; Part # never does
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A ZZAUTOTEST part exists with a very long description (and, if possible, long category/vendor names) and a long part number.
steps:
1. Narrow the browser window (or turn on more columns) so the text columns overflow.
2. Read the long Description, Category, and Vendor cells and hover each.
3. Read the long Part # cell.
expected:
1. Long text values (Description, Category, Vendor) are truncated with an ellipsis when they overflow their column.
2. The full value is available on hover.
3. The Part # is never truncated.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Inventory Value report specification version 10 (S12-R6), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
